decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform is the most heavily invested and most visibly promoted product, has moved up from a mention to a page of its own, and is central to the firm's announced direction, so management will keep investing in it and treat weak results as temporary.

Mobile field data capture has had a page of its own in both years, fits the firm's core GIS business, and represents sunk development effort the firm has publicly backed, so management is likely to keep it despite uncertain results.

The search extension was publicly announced in a new version (1.6.0) in 2019, which shows continued investment and visible commitment, so management is inclined to keep it even though the related small plugins were dropped.
